framing.verdict: The rewrite is a material improvement and passes strong interoperability checks, but swift-CAD cannot adopt it unchanged and untrusted-input budgets remain incomplete.
framing.method: Multi-perspective source review plus executable verification

findings.title: swift-CAD adapters do not conform to the new reader API
No shared byte/entity/nesting/time budget covers all import paths
SdfLayer exposes mutable derived transform caches beside canonical specs
Composition cache Sendable contract differs by platform
Capability and unsupported-feature gates overstate their coverage
Large parser and test files remain difficult to review and compile
One test variable is unnecessarily mutable

recommendedOrder: Migrate swift-CAD adapters and typed error mapping
Introduce one USDReadingLimits processing budget across USDA, USDC, USDZ, and composition
Make transform caches derived and internally invalidated
Use a single compiler-checked Sendable synchronization implementation
Replace empty unsupported inventory with an executable capability ledger
Split large sources and tests by responsibility
residualUncertainty: The entire test suite was not executed.
Hydra, Imaging, and non-core schema parity are outside the declared scope.
No historical benchmark series was reconstructed in this review.
